title: Immunofluorescence Protocol for Pax7 and Androgen Receptor in Frozen Muscle Sections
author: Hiroshi Sakai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sujeeun
materials: Dilute primary antibodies as follows in 5% Goat serum/0.05% Triton X-100/PBS. Prepare 100 µl antibody solution per slide. Add primary antibody solution to the slides. 100 µL, 5% Goat serum/0.05% Triton X-100/PBS 5 µL, anti-Pax7 (mouse IgG1, 1/20) 0.25 µL, anti-androgen receptor (rabbit, 1/400)

Dilute secondary antibodies as follows in 5% Goat serum/0.05% Triton X-100/PBS. Prepare 100 µl antibody solution per slide. Add secondary antibody solution to the slides. undetermined, 5% Goat serum/0.05% Triton X-100/PBS 0.1 µL, anti-mouse IgG1 568 (1/1000) undetermined, anti-rabbit IgG 488 (1/1000) undetermined, DAPI (1/2000)

steps.title: Fix slides with PFA
steps.instruction: Fix the slides in 4% paraformaldehyde/PBS for 5 min at room temperature, ensuring the slides are not air‑dry before fixation to avoid increased background and loss of androgen‑receptor signal.

steps.title: Wash slides after fixation
steps.instruction: Wash the slides in PBS three times, 5 min each wash.

steps.title: Prepare sodium citrate solution
steps.instruction: Fill a beaker with 500 mL of sodium citrate solution, place the beaker on a hotplate and turn the hotplate to full power. Keep the sections immersed in PBS while the solution heats.

steps.title: Heat slides in citrate solution
steps.instruction: When the sodium citrate solution reaches a boil, carefully transfer the slide chamber (containing the slides) from PBS into the boiling solution using forceps. Remove the beaker from the hotplate and let it cool for 20 min. After cooling, remove the slide chamber from the beaker.

steps.title: Wash slides after retrieval
steps.instruction: Wash the slides in PBS three times, 5 min each wash.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Block the slides with 5% goat serum and 0.05% Triton X‑100 in PBS for 1 h at room temperature. Prepare 100 µL of this blocking solution per slide, apply it, then drain the slides for a few seconds (do not rinse) and gently wipe around the sections with tissue paper.

steps.title: Wash after primary incubation
steps.instruction: Wash the slides in PBS three times, 5 min each wash.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the slides for 1 h at room temperature protected from light.

steps.title: Wash after secondary incubation
steps.instruction: Wash the slides in PBS three times, 5 min each wash.

steps.title: Mount slides
steps.instruction: Mount the slides using ProLong™ Glass Antifade Mountant and place coverslips over the sections.
